That is CATEGORICAL for this form, not a weak negative -- no further spelling of the SAME construct can reach the decision point either`. With the predecessor record's two initializer-presence forms, that is THREE initializer/statement-binding spellings on this one function all folding to byte-identical objects, so the construct class is exhausted rather than unlucky, and a fourth spelling is a do-not-retry. What still reaches codegen here is DECLARATION ORDER, which is what closed the volatile half in run 53. (2) THE RESIDUAL WAS MISCLASSIFIED IN THE INHERITED BRIEF, which called it 'the volatile-home copy family'. Measured, it is a two-atom emission-order transposition between an ADDR16_LO address materialisation and an EMB_SDA21 constant load -- the target emits `+0x164 addi r4,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)` then `+0x168 lfs f7,0(0) @lbl_803468B0(EMB_SDA21)` and ours emits them swapped -- carrying 2 words that `wf_word_diff` explicitly reports as lying `OUTSIDE every register-field class, so NO copy_register_fields rule can close this residual however small the count is`. That is a zero-build refutation of the recolor-only reading, available from the decode line alone, and it is why the rule is composed rather than plain. The single register field the permutation leaves behind (+0x164's RT, ours r3 in place where the target writes a fresh r4) is clause (b) of claim.law.pointer-decl-order-flips-addrlo-inplace-vs-fresh-destination.20260901.v1 and is discharged by the whole-function renaming together with its mirror at `+0x184 li` (target r3, ours r4).
